findings.title: OAC bucket-policy SourceArn is a distribution/* wildcard rather than the exact distribution ARN
findings.fix: Documented, justified deviation (FEAT-005 findings): buckets live in VideoDataStack and the distribution in VideoAppStack, so binding the OAC read policy to the exact distribution ARN creates an unresolvable CloudFormation dependency cycle. The confused-deputy guard is therefore any distribution in account 678602035067 rather than DESIGN's exact-distribution ARN. Acceptable for a single-tenant lab; if the cross-stack cycle is ever resolved, tighten AWS:SourceArn to the exact distribution ARN. Confidence: confirmed. Non-blocking.

summary: APPROVED. The sole MEDIUM that blocked the prior iteration is fixed: the CloudFront error_responses now map ONLY 404->/index.html (403->index.html removed, with a code comment explaining that distribution-wide custom error responses would otherwise rewrite the /media/* trusted-key-group 403), so genuine signed-cookie 403s reach hls.js and player.js's onRefresh (re-call play-url) can fire. All MUST-FIX carry-forwards verified in the actual code: signer sets CloudFront-Key-Pair-Id = CF_KEY_PAIR_ID = public_key.public_key_id with CfPublicKeyId output and CfKeyGroupId kept separate (signing.py, app_stack.py); /media/* ResponseHeadersPolicy CORS + S3 Output CORS for the localhost dev origins (app_stack.py); /health returns 503 and play-url returns 503 until the signing key loads (main.py lifespan + health + play_url); concrete alb-sg ingress TCP 80 from each PRIVATE_WITH_EGRESS /24 (10.0.2.0/24, 10.0.3.0/24) with the VpcOrigin pinned to the same subnets and the AWS-doc justification recorded in FEAT-005 findings, ALB internet_facing=False and open=False; production playback uses signed cookies (not flagged as a deviation); worker is idempotent (skip-if-Ready) with two-shape Failed handling (non-zero ffmpeg exit -> Failed+delete+no-retry; transient boto3/OS errors left for redelivery) plus the DLQ-marker Lambda's conditional UpdateItem; no port-22 ingress anywhere (test asserts it); all four buckets BLOCK_ALL + DESTROY + auto_delete_objects, table/queues/secret/log groups DESTROY; gp3 block devices on both launch templates; systemd EnvironmentFile injection from CDK-resolved refs; local play-url returns a URL to the API's own rewritten-playlist endpoint with absolute signed URLs. Evidence read (not re-run per instructions): cdk synth green for all three stacks and pytest green across iac/worker/api/dlq suites plus the uvicorn /health smoke (200 with key, 503 without), recorded in each features/FEAT-00N.json findings. FFmpeg pin was re-pinned to the durable Nov-2024 month-end snapshot of the same n7.1 linux64-gpl build with a computed SHA256 in FFMPEG.lock (original daily tag pruned upstream) -- a documented, acceptable deviation. One NIT remains (OAC SourceArn wildcard forced by the cross-stack cycle) and is non-blocking.
